name: Huey Mnemonic (Subsonic Ebonics/Underground Resistance) // Sagittarii Acid
description:
Den nye generasjonen Detroit på Hærverk!

—

Huey Mnemonic is a Detroit music producer, DJ, and sound artist with an insatiable knack for electronic music. His work is driven by a passion for Detroit Techno, Afrofuturism, world-building, and synthesized sounds.

Through his record label Ebon and design studio Mnemonic Labs, Huey leads a transformative journey in electronic music and visual storytelling. His music radiates a distinct sense of futurism, drawing audiences into immersive soundscapes at one moment, then shifting to rhythms crafted for the dance floor in the next.

Huey’s deep-rooted connection with the world of Techno extends beyond his personal projects. Working directly with Underground Resistance, Submerge, & Exhibit 3000. Huey’s tutelage under “Mad” Mike Banks has enriched his pursuit of sharing his music on a global scale and contributing to the long lineage of Detroit Techno.
